svg.title: The same nodes in the same positions, each connected once to a central protocol panel
svg.desc: The four application boxes and six data source boxes sit in exactly the positions they occupied in the previous figure, so only the wiring has changed. A tall panel labeled Model Context Protocol stands in the middle. Each application draws one line to the left edge of the panel and each data source draws one line to its right edge, so the crossing mesh is gone. A caption reads 4 + 6 = 10 implementations.
svg.text: The same nodes, with one agreed boundary in the middle
Each side implements the protocol once. Ten pieces of work instead of twenty-four.
